create.title: Select a topic to create a Capsule
create.sub-title:
Capsules are a set of questions you ask other people about a
specific topic you are knowledgeable or interested in.

create-modal.title:
Are you sure you want to
proceed with this topic?

message-to-save: To save your Capsule questionnaire enter a title
who-pay: Who will pay when replying to this Capsule?

template-messages.hi-there: Hi there, I’m here to help you create this Capsule.
template-messages.copy-and-paste: Copy & Paste any link you wish in the text box to get this conversation started. Your content will appear as a preview for your Capsule.
template-messages.start-asking: Start by asking your first Capsule question to get the conversation started.
template-messages.good-start: Good start! Now it’s possible to add as many links, audio messages and comments to make sure they truly get you.
template-messages.once-done: Once done, create next question OR press complete to finish.
template-messages.choose-title: Please choose a title that describes this Capsule..
template-messages.set-description: Please give a short description for this Capsule.
template-messages.allow-org-level: Do you allow to show your Capsule on the Profile Page of your organization (if any)?
template-messages.allow-platform-level: Do you allow to show your Capsule on the Get Help Page of We Care Remote?
template-messages.you-reade: Now you’re ready to start sharing your Capsule with your community.
template-messages.link-not-supported: This link is currently not fully supported. Rather enter another link (supported websites) or press “Skip this Step” to create your first Capsule question to get the conversation started.
template-messages.no-problem: No problem, please enter your new Capsule title.
template-messages.perfect: Perfect! Now you’re ready to start sharing your Capsule with your community.
template-messages.excellent:
Excellent! This is how your Capsule preview will look like.
Now ask your first question to get this conversation started.

ice-breaker-card.select-profile: Select a topic from your profile card to create a Capsule conversation.
ice-breaker-card.click-button: Click the button below to start creating this Capsule
ice-breaker-card.pick-topic: Pick a topic before creating a Capsule
ice-breaker-card.want-share: wants to share this Capsule with you:
ice-breaker-card.if-you-have: If you have no topics setup yet go to the settings area and pick topics your knowledgeable in.
